NormalizeVector, version 0.01

Usage: NormalizeVector [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --vector : vector to normalize
    --careful-normalize : normalize with higher numerical accuracy
    -c, --complex : run for a complex vector
    -p, --normalize-phase : change phase to make largest absolute value real and positive
